decision: Do not integrate or deploy these candidate weights. The frozen fallback adds no recovered cases, and the new cohort exposes material and foreground generalization failures.

training.metricScope: Partial annotated training pixels only; not held-out accuracy.

runtime.qualification: The four changed material pixels have foreground probabilities below 0.024. One body pixel also crosses 0.5. Strict 2e-5 and exact-threshold gates remain failed; neither tolerance nor checkpoint was changed to pass.

pipeline.qualification: Seven checked pairs are not seven exact artwork recoveries. All fallback selections were identical to production, so the exact same fit is shared. One retained production proposal lacks supported-outline status. Source-group diversity is one; no original cutting-template ground truth.

colorAblation.scope: Exploratory ablation on the already evaluated cohort; not a new held-out evaluation. Both methods use the same saved WASM foreground and unchanged locator. Alternate execution order, retain the existing two-second orientation deadline and all failures. No solver or manual ROI. Timing can change the examined orientations.
colorAblation.conclusion: Material collapse is visible but not the only failure. RGB colors with the same predicted foreground yield no extra eligible fallback; lower-edge and lobe evidence still fail.

notes.observations: Both paper identities largely collapse into one class. Foreground has a weak lower tip. Export retains the central motif but adds large frame distortions and thin false seams.
Foreground prediction loses much of the lower patterned overlap. Both color sources fail to identify both lower edges; no crop or fitted pair.
Foreground largely recognizes the rotated heart, but learned paper identities collapse. Production crop and fit preserve the horse; small strip-boundary distortions remain.
Predicted paper identities collapse across the lobes. Production fit preserves the curved grid but adds tiny isolated cutouts and changes some contacts.
Learned material patches do not follow the visible papers. Predicted outline and cap evidence fail support checks with both color sources; no fitted pair.
Body outline is broad and soft; learned paper regions omit most of the motif. Neither color-source ablation obtains a supported crop.
Learned material field loses large portions of the visible pattern. Production reconstruction is close, with minor boundary rounding.
Body silhouette is recognizable, but learned colors break up and merge parts of the motif. Both ablations fail crop support.
RGB inside predicted foreground obtains a supported shape only with extrapolated corners outside the photo; policy correctly rejects replacement. The source bottom tip is clipped.
Low contrast between papers; learned material regions do not consistently follow either paper. No supported crop with either field source.
Learned material head is almost uniform. Foreground-plus-RGB supports the crop, which production already finds. Export distorts several narrow grid contacts.
Learned material field is almost uniform; foreground has a thin unstable bottom region. Neither ablation supports a crop.
Strong reflections and shading; learned materials are almost uniform. Body silhouette alone does not yield a supported crop.

Central motif remains recognizable in the learned field but surrounding papers do not separate consistently. Fitted frame contains conspicuous false gaps and distortions despite 2.41% derived-mask disagreement.
Foreground misses a substantial pale region and separates off a patch near the lower edge. Neither method supports a crop.

Learned field recovers much of the flower but not consistent paper identities across the lobes. Production retains an unsupported editable crop proposal; its resulting flower fit is visually close and passes geometry checks.

nextExperiment: Use the frozen foreground as a rough search-region proposal; recover precise paper boundaries from original RGB. Keep current support checks, compare to the saved production baseline, and treat this already inspected cohort as development data. A subsequent source-held-out cohort is required for a release decision.

cliRuns: actual production JPEG import and WASM inference on all 16
validation.siteValidation: No src or static changes since the deployed, green-CI release; use its full app checks and live drawing QA rather than repeating heavy unchanged tests.
